summary.text: Headquarters at Abejukolo. Igala tradition remembers Omala, and the old town of Otutubatu, as the place where the Igala first entered the land from Kwararafa. Its paramount ruler is the Onu Ife.

peoples.name: Akpoto speakers

history.text: Igala tradition makes Omala, and the ancient spiritual town of Otutubatu, the point where the Igala first entered the land from Kwararafa: an aged Attah settled here and sent his younger brother on south with the people.

livelihoods.text: Bagana market draws traders from Benue, Enugu, Nasarawa and other states; barter is still practised there, and Bagana smoked fish is a known delicacy. The area holds crude oil, coal, kaolin and limestone.
